content: Reproducible research pipelines freeze and hash artifacts (code/config/data) with tamper-evident manifests recording git commit hash, config snapshot hash, dependency pins, and dataset hash, enabling exact replay without re-fetching external state. Best practice separates the frozen evaluation bank from mutable pipeline code and records timestamps/system info alongside hashes for traceability. This generically confirms (does not originate) the project's own artifact-freeze-and-hash discipline.
